items.q: Loggins Catering was down in the next block.

ctx.x: And where was that in relation to where Loggins Catering was?
Loggins Catering was down in the next block. A block down--down by where the Koreans are now, you know...where that Korean Church and things are. He was down on the next corner. Catering, yeah.
I know Roy Loggins, Mr. Loggins' son who became a jazz disc jockey.
